== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His pentakill on July 24th, 2020 was the first-ever pentakill for a jungler in the LCK. 
* Often named Polar Bear by teammates and fans.
* Breaking the record of player who has the most POG (MVP) points in one split, with 1600 POG points in the [[LCK 2022 Spring]]
** It surpassed the previous record of [[Ssumday]] in the [[LCK 2015 Summer]] and [[Smeb]] in the [[LCK 2016 Spring]] (both of them got 1400 POG (MVP) points)
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on March 10, 2023.
** Was the 22nd player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]], [[Rascal]] and [[deokdam]]
** The fourth jungler to reach 1000 kills after [[Score]], [[Ambition]] and [[Peanut]].
* Reached 1500 LCK kills on July 23, 2025.
** Was the 17th player and 3rd jungler reach 1500 kills.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on July 16, 2023.
** Was the 13th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], [[Bdd]], [[Keria]], [[Life]], and [[BeryL]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 31, 2024.
** Was the 9th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after GorillA, Faker, Lehends, Peanut, Keria, Deft, Bdd, and BeryL.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on January 20, 2024, becoming the 14th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Lehends]]/[[Kiin]], and [[Cuzz]].
* Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on May 01, 2025, becoming the 8th player to do so after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], Bdd, Chovy, Lehends, and Kiin.
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on March 22, 2024, becoming the 15th player to do so.
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on May 23, 2025, becoming the 12th player to do so.
* Reached 1000 international assists during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 05, 2025 in Upper Bracket Round 2 against [[Anyone's Legend]], becoming the 7th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], Faker, [[xiaohu]], [[meiko]], [[Keria]], and [[Caps]].
* Reached 100 international wins during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 13, 2025 against [[T1]] in Grand Finals, becoming the 7th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], [[Keria]], and [[Oner]]/[[Gumayusi]].
* Has reached Rank 1 on the Korean Solo Queue Ladder multiple times.
* Started playing League of Legends in 6th grade. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ckLtBw_oVYc 데프트야, 나야? | Kia 안에서 우린 토크를 나눴지 EP.4] ''youtube.com''</ref>  
* Got to Master by only playing {{ci|Yasuo}}.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK Regular Season MVP x2 (Summer 2019, Spring 2021)
* Player of the Split x1 (Spring 2022)
* Worlds Finals MVP x1 (2020)
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x6 (Summer 2020, Spring 2021, Spring 2022, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, LCK 2025)
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2021)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2023, Summer 2023)
